notes: The numeral in "one thing" is dropped, but Cardinality rides on a group and there is no licensed carrier for a singular count, so the witness-only encoding looks forced by the instruction set rather than chosen. Keeping "boils down" whole as a phrasal verb and putting its "to"-object in a preposition-named oblique matches the "clamped down on" / "referred to" pattern, and the simple present correctly gets no status atom.
